from typing import List


def next_permutation(nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    """Returns the next permutation of nums in lexicographic order as a new list.

    If nums is already the last permutation, returns the first one (sorted ascending).
    The input is not modified.
    """
    res = list(nums)
    n = len(res)

    # Find the largest index i such that res[i] < res[i + 1]
    i = n - 2
    while i >= 0 and res[i] >= res[i + 1]:
        i -= 1

    if i >= 0:
        # Find the largest index j greater than i such that res[i] < res[j]
        j = n - 1
        while res[i] >= res[j]:
            j -= 1
        # Swap the value of res[i] with that of res[j]
        res[i], res[j] = res[j], res[i]

    # Reverse the sequence from i + 1 up to the end of the array
    left, right = i + 1, n - 1
    while left < right:
        res[left], res[right] = res[right], res[left]
        left += 1
        right -= 1

    return res
